tool.method: Sequentially decode video frames, then inspect requested frame stills at listed timestamps.

hero.observations: The sampled sequence presents seven named chapters: Spark, Direction, Find the Rhythm, Give It Form, Open the Frame, Meaning, Signature. It opens on a tiny point on near-black, develops a thin warm line through editorial serif phrases and a pause/pulse motif, inverts to a cream framed 'A world' / 'Make room' card with a cool path, then returns to near-black for 'Meaning, in motion' and the orange/cool-blue KINETIC signature. In sampled stills the dominant grammar is planar typography, line/point drawing and layout/color change; there is no obvious perspective-led camera move or deep 3D staging.

loop.observations: The loop holds 'Ideas, in motion.' at center, with the KINETIC wordmark small at upper left, two concentric elliptical tracks and warm/cool luminous points travelling around the tracks. The sampled frame changes are primarily orbiting light points; the text and camera remain compositionally steady.

creative_implications: Parallax is commissioned to move beyond the established planar line/point grammar into purposeful typography in real spatial depth and a camera move that reveals meaning—not a generic orbit or parallax filter.
Glyphcraft is commissioned to make letterform structure itself carry changing meaning; it should not merely inherit the line, orbit, palette or fade-in as its main event.
Both should preserve Kinetic's editorial restraint and legibility where useful while creating a distinctly more ambitious visual payoff.
scope_and_limits: The complete video frame streams were sequentially decoded (810/810 hero; 256/256 loop) and representative stills were visually inspected; this is not an uninterrupted full-speed perceptual watch.
Audio was not decoded or listened to. The publication receipt's audio metadata is not an independent hearing test.
This is a commissioner sample-level visual observation, not a score, artistic approval, formal acceptance, or change to Kinetic's public task status (still in review).
